description: This file appears to be a documentation/source reference for the 'Dialog' class in the Playwright API, detailing how it is dispatched, methods, related events, and usage examples in multiple programming languages.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeunload) triggered on a page, providing methods to interact with it.

methods.name: Dialog.accept
methods.description: Accepts the dialog, optionally with prompt text if the dialog type is prompt.

methods.name: Dialog.message
methods.description: Returns the message displayed in the dialog.

methods.name: Dialog.page
methods.description: Returns the page associated with the dialog, if available.

methods.name: Dialog.type
methods.description: Returns the type of the dialog, such as alert, confirm, prompt, or beforeunload.
